rationale: Adds a compact late-phase training loss curriculum that downweights prefix positions while keeping the eval-stride tail fully weighted, aiming to align updates with the exact sliding-window validation metric without changing final evaluation or the recurrent-tail export path. The edit reuses the current reverse-tail baseline, keeps shapes compile-stable, and folds duplicated token-loss code so the script stays under the line cap.
title: Late Tail-Weighted Recurrence Curriculum
